points.description: Uses labelled/classified training data and, for a new data point, identifies its k nearest neighbours (e.g., by computing distances to the stored labelled points and selecting the k smallest).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if neighbours are mentioned but the use of distance/nearness or the value k is unclear.

points.description: Takes a majority vote of the classes among the k nearest neighbours and assigns the new data point to the class with the most votes.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the class is assigned but the voting/majority step is not explicit.
